$:set -euo pipefail
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
SRC='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448.png'
DST='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean.png'
test -f "$SRC" && test ! -e "$DST"
test "$(sha256sum "$SRC" | awk '{print $1}')" = 'ae82854dcee417bec13dbfdb305b97239059c0dbd78387f6347c2f60267a5b58'
python3 -m venv /tmp/fishfry_cw05_only_venv
/tmp/fishfry_cw05_only_venv/bin/python -m pip -q install Pillow
/tmp/fishfry_cw05_only_venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageChops
from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
src=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448.png')
dst=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean.png')
with Image.open(src) as original:
    source=original.convert('RGB')
assert source.size==(1448,1448)
rotated=source.rotate(-0.5,resample=Image.Resampling.BICUBIC,expand=False,fillcolor='white')
assert rotated.size==(1448,1448)
assert ImageChops.difference(source,rotated).getbbox() is not None
rotated.save(dst,format='PNG',compress_level=6)
with Image.open(dst) as loaded:
    assert loaded.size==(1448,1448)
    assert ImageChops.difference(loaded.convert('RGB'),rotated).getbbox() is None
print('SOURCE',src,flush=True)
print('TRANSFORM','clockwise 0.5 degrees; BICUBIC; expand=false; white fill; no overlays',flush=True)
print('OUTPUT',dst,'DIMENSIONS',rotated.size,'BYTES',dst.stat().st_size,'SHA256',sha256(dst.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
print('PNG_READBACK','pixel-identical to in-memory rotated result',flush=True)
PY
git add -- "$DST"
test "$(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l)" -eq 1
git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m 'Rotate clean centered fish fry image 0.5 degree clockwise'
gh auth setup-git
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8;do
  printf 'PUSH_ATTEMPT %s\n' "$attempt"
  git fetch --quiet origin main
  git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' rebase origin/main
  if git push origin HEAD:main;then
    printf 'COMMITTED ';git rev-parse HEAD
    printf 'REMOTE_HEAD ';gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha
    gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$DST" --jq '[.path,.size,.sha] | @tsv'
    printf 'LOCAL_BLOB ';git hash-object "$DST"
    exit 0
  fi
done
echo 'PUBLISH_FAILED' >&2
exit 1
